meta.name: exec-briefing-memo
meta.description: Decision needed + recommendation + evidence + tradeoffs, 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把复杂材料压成可拍板的一页简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速从长篇材料提炼决策要点
copy.tagline_en: Condense complex materials into a one-page decision memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly distill key decision points from lengthy materials

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把散乱材料（会议记录、调研、销售数据等）压成一页可拍板的决策简报：先给结论与建议，再列证据、权衡表、风险与下一步，且不编造数字和事实。
howto.when: 当你提供会议记录、调研材料、销售反馈等复杂信息，并要求产出高管决策简报时触发；也可在用户指定时按决策场景选用对应风格。

say.text: 把这份会议记录整理成一页高管决策简报
say.note: Claude 会按模板输出含建议与权衡的 memo。

say.text: 用深色 command center 风格做一份 go/no-go 简报
say.note: 紧急决策场景会自动切换为 command 风格。

say.text: 材料面向董事会，请生成正式 board paper
say.note: 输出董事会纸质议案风格，附证据与风险。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude condenses scattered material (meeting notes, research, sales data, etc.) into a one-page decision memo: conclusion and recommendation first, then evidence, tradeoffs, risks, and next actions, without inventing numbers or facts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide complex input like meeting notes, research material, or sales feedback and ask for an executive decision memo; style variants can be selected based on the decision scenario.

say_en.text: Turn this meeting notes into a one-page executive decision memo.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a memo with recommendation and tradeoffs.

say_en.text: Make a go/no-go briefing in dark command-center style.
say_en.note: Switches to a command-style layout for urgent calls.

say_en.text: This is for the board; generate a formal board paper.
say_en.note: Produces a formal board-paper format with evidence and risks.
